papers.title_en: DiD It in 87 Minutes: A Label-Free Softmax-to-Linear Adaptation of Vision Transformers for Object Detection
papers.authors: Huaiyuan Qin, Gabriel James Goenawan, Zihang Lin, Muli Yang, Hongyuan Zhu
papers.evidence: 将Softmax注意力ViT转换为线性注意力用于目标检测
papers.tldr: 将训练好的Softmax注意力ViT检测器转换为线性注意力时，直接替换会严重掉点，无标签蒸馏亦失效。本文提出检测器接口蒸馏（DiD），仅训练线性注意力骨干，对齐冻结教师检测器接口特征张量。在DOTA-v1.5上，DiD超越现有基线并匹配全监督模型，约87分钟完成转换，推理延迟降低62%、峰值内存降低49%。该方法提供无需标签复用Softmax检测器的简洁途径，倡导接口感知的架构转换目标。
papers.abstract_en: While linear attention is a compelling mechanism for high-resolution object detection due to its reduced cost for global token mixing, converting the Softmax-attention ViT backbone of a trained detector into a linear-attention one is not a trivial drop-in replacement. Directly swapping the attention operator leads to severe performance degradation, and generic label-free distillation, though effective for classification, often fails on detection tasks. We argue that the central challenge is \textit{detector-interface preservation}: the converted backbone must reproduce the exact feature tensors expected by the fixed downstream detector, rather than merely imitating internal Softmax hidden states. To address this, we introduce Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD), a label-free conversion method that exclusively trains the linear-attention backbone by aligning detector-facing interface tensors with those of a frozen Softmax teacher. On DOTA-v1.5, DiD substantially outperforms established baselines and matches supervised, fully trained linear models. Adaptation completes in roughly 87 minutes on 4 GPUs, and the linearized backbone cuts inference latency by ~62% and peak memory by ~49%. We hope our findings offer the community a simple, label-free route to reusing trained Softmax detectors as efficient linear ones, and encourage interface-aware objectives in future architecture-conversion work.

papers.title_en: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Yaokun Liu, Yifan Liu, Daniel Yue Zhang, Ruichen Yao, Zelin Li, Dong Wang
papers.evidence: 多智能体系统通信及智能体间不确定性传播
papers.tldr: 面向大语言模型多智能体系统，现有不确定性量化无法处理智能体间错误传播。本文将多智能体执行建模为通信图，提出传播感知的不确定性量化框架PropUQ-MAS，结合局部不确定性与上游消息继承不确定性估计每一步可靠性。实验表明方法在AUROC和PRR上分别提升6.10%与47.58%，有效提升多智能体系统不确定性评估质量。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) solve complex tasks through communication among role-specialized agents. However, inter-agent dependencies introduce reliability risks beyond isolated agent failures. For instance, errors in intermediate messages could be inherited and amplified by downstream agents. Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods mainly target isolated responses or single-agent reasoning, and therefore fail to capture uncertainty propagation in MAS. To this end, we propose PropUQ-MAS, an error propagation-aware UQ framework that represents MAS execution as a communication-structured graph and estimates each step's reliability by combining local uncertainty with uncertainty inherited from upstream messages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PropUQ-MAS consistently improves UQ in MAS, with average relative gains of +6.10% in AUROC and +47.58% in PRR.

papers.title_en: The Collaboration Tax: How Much LLM Multi-Agent Systems Pay to Coordinate
papers.authors: Weixiang Sun, Zehong Wang, Hong Huang, Colby Nelson, Yanfang Ye
papers.evidence: 量化协作型LLM多智能体系统中的协调成本
papers.tldr: 多智能体LLM系统虽广泛应用，但两个模型协作相比单独行动的性能损失尚不明确。本文提出团队去中心化损失形式的协作税，并在32个任务上测量11个模型。发现该税沿两个无例外轴：按任务类别一致排序，随模型能力单调递减；其机制并非推理缺陷，而是包含无根据主张、不查询伙伴、未整合观点和不重新推导的四阶段对话级联。提示干预可大幅缩小差距，且异构对中税收由强方主导。这表明LLM协作成本可测量、可预测且部分可降低。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems built from large language models are deployed widely, yet how much performance is lost when two LLMs must coordinate rather than act alone remains unclear. We formulate the collaboration tax as the team-decentralisation loss of a two-player cooperative game with private information, with two propositions characterising its sign and its equivalence to a max-superadditivity violation. We operationalise this definition on 32 solo-tractable tasks grouped by source of grounding friction and measure it on 11 models from 7 providers. The tax is structured along two no-exception axes: a category ordering across every model and a monotonic decrease with capability. The proximate mechanism is not a reasoning deficit but a four-stage conversational cascade in which agents make ungrounded claims, fail to query the partner, skip integrating both views, and accept the answer without re-derivation. The tax is mechanically predictable from conversation features and partly tractable: a prompt intervention targeting all four stages closes a substantial fraction of the gap, with the dominant bottleneck differing across categories. In heterogeneous pairs the tax is pulled toward the stronger partner rather than the additive midpoint, empirically realising the max-superadditivity violation predicted by our framework. Together these results recast collaboration in LLM systems as a measurable, predictable, and partly tractable cost.

papers.title_en: The Interaction Tax: When Communication Erases Diversity in Multi-Agent Teams
papers.authors: Summer Eunhyung Ann, Haokun Liu, Chenhao Tan
papers.evidence: 通信对多智能体团队多样性的影响
papers.tldr: 多智能体LLM交互的效果存在矛盾，部分研究称有增益，部分称在同等预算下无改善。本文指出关键在于交互信息类型：不同模型族本有结构差异，但完整输出交互会在一轮内导致趋同，抹除多样性。作者将其称为交互税，并在11个验证器评分任务中测试，发现独立生成更稳健，完整交互使智能体锚定首个方案，批判仅对易发现和修复的规则有效。多智能体表现更取决于交换的信息而非数量。
papers.abstract_en: Does multi-agent LLM interaction help or hurt? Some work reports gains from debate (Du et al., 2024), critique loops (Chen et al., 2025), and mixture-of-agents synthesis (Wang et al., 2025), while other work finds that interaction adds cost without improving quality under equal budgets (Tran & Kiela, 2026; Xu et al., 2026; Jarrett et al., 2025), or that independent sampling already captures multi-agent gains (Li et al., 2024). We argue this contradiction partly reflects a missing distinction, because not all multi-agent communication is equal. Different model families find structurally different solutions, but when agents read each other's complete outputs, their proposals converge within one round, erasing the diversity that motivates using multiple models. We call this the interaction tax. We test 11 verifier-scored optimization tasks under matched budgets and find that full-solution interaction is a weak default. Independent proposal generation avoids this collapse. Full-solution interaction mainly makes agents stay close to the first solution they see instead of trying different approaches, and critique helps only if the violated rule is easy for the LLM to find and fix. These results suggest that multi-agent performance depends less on the number of agents than on the information they exchange, and interaction helps only when agents share the right information at the right time.

papers.authors: Yuxin Cheng, Chang Liu, Hanxin Yu, Haochen Tan, Taiqiang Wu, Weiqiang Jin, Jie Ran, Kaibo Wang, Xiaoguang Li, Haoli Bai, Graziano Chesi, Ngai Wong
papers.evidence: 利用文本交互轨迹对多智能体系统进行持续优化
papers.tldr: 现有基于搜索的多智能体系统优化面临优化范围与进化稳定性的权衡，且离散搜索隔离了跨谱系见解。为此提出OptiMAS，一种基于统一ReAct基础设施的连续数据驱动优化范式，利用交互轨迹和任务反馈作为损失信号，并配备双轨记忆机制。在四个基准和三种LLM后端上，OptiMAS相比手工系统和进化方法取得竞争性或更优性能。这项工作为鲁棒的自动化多智能体进化奠定了基础。
papers.abstract_en: Automated evolution of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) holds significant potential for reducing the manual effort required to design and optimize LLM-based agent architectures. However, extant search-based paradigms face a fundamental trade-off, where an expanded optimization scope exacerbates evolutionary instability, while discrete branch-and-discard search isolates insights across lineages. To address these limitations, we propose a continuous, data-driven optimization paradigm built upon a unified ReAct-based infrastructure that reconciles a broad optimization scope with operational stability. Under this paradigm, we present OptiMAS, a task-agnostic agentic optimizer that leverages textual interaction trajectories and task feedback as loss signals for end-to-end MAS evolution. Equipped with a novel dual-track memory mechanism, OptiMAS sustains performance improvement over extended optimization horizons. Evaluation on four heterogeneous agentic benchmarks with three varying scale and accessibility LLM backbones, demonstrates that OptiMAS consistently achieves competitive or superior accuracy relative to both domain-specialized hand-crafted systems and existing evolutionary methods. Our work establishes a practical milestone toward robust, automated MAS evolution.

papers.title_en: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use
papers.authors: Mian Zhang, Manasi Sharma, Sheng Zhang, Minglai Yang, Kejian Shi, Ying Liu, Zhiyu Zoey Chen, Daniel Yue Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于主干-分支图的多智能体计算机使用协调
papers.tldr: 多智能体计算机使用代理将任务分解到并行虚拟机执行，但虚拟机状态无法合并成为关键瓶颈。现有方法临时处理该约束，缺乏系统性方案。本文提出Spine-Branch协调框架，以骨干流程保持连续虚拟机状态，分支任务并行收集所需信息，完成后即丢弃，从而避免状态合并。在200个长时任务及三种骨干模型上，成功率提升6%至16.5%，成本降低34%至70%，表明显式建模该约束可让多智能体系统高效扩展。
papers.abstract_en: Computer use agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems that decompose a task into multiple subtasks executed across parallel virtual machines (VMs). However, a critical physical bottleneck is that the state of two VMs cannot be merged. Previous systems handle this ad-hoc rather than treating it as a first-class concern. We propose Spine-Branch Coordination for multi-agent computer use, a framework that decomposes a task into a "spine-branch" graph, where the spine carries the main task flow with continuous VM state and branch tasks execute in parallel to collect information the spine needs to complete the task. Branch VMs are discarded once their tasks finish, so no VM merging ever occurs. Experiments show that on 200 long-horizon tasks from Odysseys and across three CUA backbones, Spine-Branch improves success rate over the baseline system by 6.0% to 16.5%, while reducing per-task cost by 34% to 70%, indicating that explicitly modeling VM-state merging constraint enables multi-agent computer use to scale efficiently.

papers.title_en: From Diagnosis to Redesign: Using Quantitative Ethnography to Improve Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
papers.authors: Vedant Khatri, Anthony Cusimano, Zachari Swiecki, Zhen Xu, Xiner Liu, Renzhe Yu
papers.evidence: 通过话语分析研究多智能体交互动态
papers.tldr: 多智能体大语言模型系统虽能分解任务，但多智能体共存并不保证推理连贯或输出符合目标。本文引入定量人种学方法，以自动作文评分为例，利用认知网络分析建模五智能体辩论系统的话语，比较正确与错误评分决策的交互模式差异。根据差异修改提示词后，准确率从27.78%提升至40.28%，错误辩论的话语模式也趋近正确辩论。该方法支持从诊断到重设计的AI推理改进循环，为优化多智能体系统提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are designed to improve reasoning by decomposing tasks across multiple agents with specialized functions, but the presence of multiple agents does not inherently guarantee coherent reasoning or outputs that align with task objectives. This paper introduces a quantitative ethnographic (QE) approach for diagnosing and redesigning multi-agent LLM systems based on the discourse produced through agent interactions. We test this approach using automated essay scoring as an example context, applying Epistemic Network Analysis (ENA) to model a five-agent multi-agent debate system and examine differences between debates that produced correct versus incorrect scoring decisions. Results show that, in the initial system, correct scoring decisions were characterized by rubric-grounded justification, agreement, and elaboration. Incorrect scoring decisions, in contrast, were characterized by extended proposition-challenge-response exchanges that were less consistently tied to rubric criteria. We then used the findings to revise the agents' prompts. The revised system improved exact scoring accuracy from 27.78% to 40.28% and shifted the discourse of incorrect debates toward the rubric-grounded pattern of correct ones, making the two nearly indistinguishable. Based on these results, we argue that QE can support a diagnostic-to-redesign loop for AI reasoning by tracing how patterns of agent interaction relate to system performance, informing prompt redesign, and evaluating whether those redesigns change both outcomes and interaction patterns.

papers.title_en: Artificial Empathy: Towards a Framework for Unsupervised Agency Detection and Policy Reconstruction
papers.authors: Peter Kuhn, Chris Pang, Sonakshi Chauhan
papers.evidence: 从观察中无监督地识别并建模其他智能体
papers.tldr: 背景：现实中AI需从纯观察中识别并建模其他智能体，这是合作能力的基础，但比逆强化学习更少约束，尚未被充分探索。方法：本文提出一个框架，利用在独立辅助任务上预训练的强化学习智能体作为先验，用于无监督的智能体检测与策略重建。结果：该框架无需外部监督或显式奖励，即可从原始观察中提取代理性证据并重建其行为策略。意义：为人工同理心研究提供了可扩展的计算基础，有望推动自主协作系统的发展。
papers.abstract_en: We study how an AI system can identify and model other agents in its environment from observation alone, which is a capability necessary for cooperative behaviour in the real world. This problem is less constrained than inverse reinforcement learning and remains largely unexplored. We propose a framework that uses a reinforcement learning agent, trained on an independent task as a prior about agentic dynamics, to perform agency detection and policy reconstruction.
